research.why: A wrong fact here ships in the piece. Spend reasoning to match.

drafting.why: Style work with a human gate before anything publishes.

scheduling.why: Mechanical work, but keep the log: low effort can mean zero readable reasoning, so the tool-call records are the only audit trail.

publishing.why: Public actions under a person's name. Wrong is expensive.

note: fallback stays null on purpose: a task class with no budget is an error. If you want a fallback, write one here deliberately.
